title: Flashcard
description: A two-sided study card that flips between a prompt and its answer, for spaced-repetition review.

support.notes: Two-sided study card: front/back/footer named slots with plain-text front/back properties, translated front/back captions and optional hint, controlled (flipped, null = uncontrolled) or defaultFlipped state with flippedchange, flipOnClick, disabled, y/x axis, elevated/outline/filled variants, three sizes and minHeight. Both faces share one CSS grid cell (the card fits the taller face); the hidden face is aria-hidden and the back is a polite live region. Tap to flip only: no keyboard toggling and no prefers-reduced-motion crossfade in mini programs. The CSS 3D rotateY/rotateX flip, backface-visibility and the grid stack need the WebView renderer (Skyline does not support CSS grid or 3D transforms). Taps on interactive slotted content also flip the card (no DOM event path). The footer wrapper is always rendered (slot content cannot be detected). Native component tests and package builds pass. Selected selection, disabled-switch, overlay and theme flows were checked in the WeChat Developer Tools simulator, not on a physical device; controlled input remains unverified and automator page RPC timed out. This is not all-API or device E2E validation.

events.name: flippedchange
events.description: Requested face (true: the back); a controlled owner must publish the accepted flipped prop.

vars.name: --flashcard-min-height
vars.description: Minimum height of the card (defaults to 12rem; the minHeight prop sets it); the card grows to fit the taller face

vars.name: --flashcard-bg-color
vars.description: Background color of the faces (defaults to --surface-color, --surface-muted-color with variant="filled")

vars.name: --flashcard-radius
vars.description: Corner radius of the faces (defaults to --radius-lg)

vars.name: --flashcard-shadow
vars.description: Shadow of the faces (variant="elevated"; defaults to --shadow-lg)

vars.name: --flashcard-padding
vars.description: Padding of the faces (defaults to the size's spacing)

vars.name: --flashcard-font-size
vars.description: Font size of the face content (defaults to the size's font size)

vars.name: --flashcard-label-color
vars.description: Text color of the face captions

translationResources.title: Flashcard
translationResources.description: A two-sided study card that flips between a prompt and its answer, for spaced-repetition review.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: Click the card, or press Enter / Space on it, to flip it with a 3D rotation. The card is a toggle button (aria-pressed); the hidden face is inert and the back is a polite live region, so the revealed answer is announced.

controlled.title: Controlled review with rating buttons
controlled.description: flipped / onFlippedChange control the face; footer holds rating buttons below the card (it does not flip). frontLabel / backLabel replace the default "Question" / "Answer" captions.

axis-variants.title: Axis, variants and sizes
axis-variants.description: axis="x" flips vertically; variant matches Card (elevated, outline, filled) and size scales the padding and type. Both faces share one grid cell, so the card is as tall as the taller face.

reduced-disabled.title: Disabled and programmatic flips
reduced-disabled.description: disabled blocks flipping and dims the card; with flipOnClick={false} the card is not a button and only flipped turns it. Under prefers-reduced-motion the faces crossfade instead of rotating.

FlashcardProps.front: Content of the front face (the prompt)
FlashcardProps.back: Content of the back face (the answer)
FlashcardProps.footer: Content below the card, not flipped (e.g. rating buttons)
FlashcardProps.frontLabel: Small caption of the front face; null, false or "" hides it
FlashcardProps.backLabel: Small caption of the back face; null, false or "" hides it
FlashcardProps.hint: Hint on the front face (shown with showHint while the card flips on click)
FlashcardProps.showHint: Shows the hint on the front face
FlashcardProps.flipped: Whether the back is shown (controlled; pair with onFlippedChange)
FlashcardProps.defaultFlipped: Whether the back is initially shown (uncontrolled)
FlashcardProps.onFlippedChange: Called with the next flipped state
FlashcardProps.flipOnClick: Clicking the card (or Enter / Space on it) flips it; when false the card is not a button and only flipped flips it
FlashcardProps.disabled: Blocks flipping and dims the card
FlashcardProps.minHeight: Minimum height of the card (a number is in px); the card grows to fit the taller face

cssVars.--flashcard-min-height: Minimum height of the card (defaults to 12rem; the minHeight prop sets it); the card grows to fit the taller face
cssVars.--flashcard-bg-color: Background color of the faces (defaults to --surface-color, --surface-muted-color with variant="filled")
cssVars.--flashcard-radius: Corner radius of the faces (defaults to --radius-lg)
cssVars.--flashcard-shadow: Shadow of the faces (variant="elevated"; defaults to --shadow-lg)
cssVars.--flashcard-padding: Padding of the faces (defaults to the size's spacing)
cssVars.--flashcard-font-size: Font size of the face content (defaults to the size's font size)
cssVars.--flashcard-label-color: Text color of the face captions

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: front / back are plain-text attributes (the front / back slots take rich content). Click the card, or press Enter / Space on it, to flip it; the flipped attribute reflects the face.

controlled.title: Review with rating buttons
controlled.description: minerva-flipped-change reports user flips (cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the face); the footer slot holds the rating buttons, which set the flipped property.

axis-variants.title: Axis, variants and sizes
axis-variants.description: axis="x" flips vertically; variant (elevated, outline, filled) and size are also custom states (:state(variant-outline), :state(size-small)...).

reduced-disabled.title: Disabled and programmatic flips
reduced-disabled.description: disabled blocks flipping; flip-on-click="false" leaves only the flipped property. Under prefers-reduced-motion the faces crossfade.

events.minerva-flipped-change: The user flipped the card (detail: { flipped }); cancelable.

slots.front: Content of the front face (the prompt; falls back to the front attribute)
slots.back: Content of the back face (the answer; falls back to the back attribute)
slots.footer: Content below the card, not flipped (e.g. rating buttons)

methods.toggle: Flips the card like a user flip (fires minerva-flipped-change).
